command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
cd "$VIS"
echo HOST=$(hostname)
test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein
echo '=== LIVE SUBJECT ==='
sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js
echo '=== PARALLAX FILES ==='
find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %s %p\n' | sort
echo '=== IDENTIFY ==='
find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r identify -verbose 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Image:|  Format:|  Geometry:|  Colorspace:|  Type:|  Alpha:|  Filesize:|  Signature:)' || true
echo '=== HASHES ==='
find kopf_rgba_parallax -maxdepth 2 -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum
echo '=== CODE REFERENCES ==='
grep -RIn --exclude-dir=chrome-profile --exclude-dir=.go_backups --exclude='*.png' --exclude='*.jpg' --exclude='*.jpeg' -E 'kopf_rgba_parallax|Depth[-_ ]?Anything|parallax|depth[_ -]?map|depth[_ -]?anything' . 2>/dev/null | head -300 || true
echo '=== NEARBY GENERATORS / MANIFESTS ==='
find . -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*depth*' -o -iname '*parallax*' -o -iname '*manifest*' -o -iname '*provenance*' \) -not -path './chrome-profile/*' -printf '%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %s %p\n' | sort | head -300
echo '=== DUPLICATE HASH SEARCH ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, os
root=Path('.')
ps=[p for p in (root/'kopf_rgba_parallax').rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
want={hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest():p for p in ps}
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file() or 'chrome-profile' in p.parts or '.go_backups' in p.parts or p in ps:
        continue
    try:
        if p.stat().st_size>20_000_000: continue
        h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    except Exception:
        continue
    if h in want:
        print('DUP',h,want[h],p)
PY
echo PARALLAX_PROVENANCE_READONLY_DONE=1
